propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with a reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets whose relation graph includes the broken directory.
The error names the broken ticket (the empty directory), not the ticket being reviewed, giving a wrong-direction debugging signal when an unrelated ticket's plan review fails.
Empty ticket directories are invisible to git and cannot be tracked or gitignored, so they persist in local clones and are unreachable by pulling shared history.
After removing event-less directories and making no other changes, the same plan review command on the same tree returns PASS with exit 0, proving the directory is the causal factor.

The reducer should tolerate event-less directories by skipping them with a warning naming the path, rather than failing the whole snapshot, since an empty directory carries no information needed for relation snapshots.
